acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-tasks doctor` reports dispatcher work-state reader health from the dispatch ledger, with tests for healthy, failing and timed-out readers.
TQD-V0-001 is amended in the same change; doc-gates pass.
body: Deferred from V1-1510 (PR beamfall/corvint#993, GitHub #984). #993 shows reader health {ok,since,lastError,failedTicks} in `dispatch status` (CAL-V0-270) but `corvint-tasks doctor` does not report it. Owner ("you choose", 2026-10-16) chose not to amend TQD-V0-001 to cover doctor until doctor actually reports it. Scope: doctor surfaces the dispatch-state/5 reader health and the same timeout wording as CAL-V0-274, then amend TQD-V0-001 in the same change. Also consider ps and host-pressure reader health (remaining issue in the #993 report).
title: tasks doctor: report dispatcher work-state reader health (TQD-V0-001 amendment deferred from V1-1510)
